methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing for AI video-generation tools (Runway, Synthesia, HeyGen, Pika, Descript, Captions, Luma Dream Machine) was collected from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14. Runway, Pika, and Luma display prices with an annual-billing default toggle; monthlyUsd records the annual-equivalent monthly rate (the smallest published self-serve price), with the estimated month-to-month rate noted in the plan notes and annualDiscountPct set to the published discount. Synthesia and Descript clearly publish both monthly and annual rates; monthlyUsd is the month-to-month list price. HeyGen's pricing page geo-redirected to EUR; USD figures were taken from USD price references embedded in the site's German-language FAQ section (heygen.com/pricing) and cross-checked against an independent aggregator; Creator annual rate ($24/mo) confirmed by FAQ text. Captions publishes month-to-month USD prices only with no specific annual amounts shown; annualDiscountPct is null for all Captions plans. Enterprise / contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd null. These are not telephony products; minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan. hipaa, baa, and bilingual are null unless explicitly stated by the vendor.

vendors.name: Runway
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from runwayml.com/pricing on 2026-06-14. Page defaults to annual billing with '20% off' toggle. The $12/$28/$76 figures are the annual-equivalent monthly rates; estimated month-to-month rates ($15/$35/$95) are not published on the page — derived from the stated 20% discount. Enterprise requires scheduling a demo.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 125 one-time credits (approx. 25 seconds of Gen-4 Turbo video). Max 5 users per workspace. No subscription required.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $12/user/mo billed annually ($144/user/year); estimated ~$15/user/mo on monthly billing (20% premium, exact monthly rate not published). 625 credits/month. Max 5 users per workspace.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $28/user/mo billed annually ($336/user/year); estimated ~$35/user/mo on monthly billing (20% premium, exact monthly rate not published). 2,250 credits/month. Max 10 users per workspace.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: $76/user/mo billed annually ($912/user/year); estimated ~$95/user/mo on monthly billing (20% premium, exact monthly rate not published). 9,500 credits/month. Max 10 users per workspace.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales / schedule a demo. Includes SSO, custom credit amounts, advanced security, workspace analytics, priority support.

vendors.name: Synthesia
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from synthesia.io/pricing on 2026-06-14. Both monthly and annual rates are published on the page. Page explicitly states 'NEW LOWER PRICES' with Starter annual saving '38%'. Creator annual discount calculated from published figures ($89 monthly vs $64 annual = ~28%). Enterprise is custom quote only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1,200 credits/month (up to ~10 minutes of video). AI avatars and 160+ voices. No credit card required.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $29/mo month-to-month; $18/mo equivalent billed annually (38% off, $216/year). Includes 1,200 credits/month (10 min/mo) on monthly plan or 14,500 credits/year (120 min/year) on annual plan. Personal avatars, 160+ languages.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: $89/mo month-to-month; $64/mo equivalent billed annually (~28% off, $768/year). Includes 3,600 credits/month (30 min/mo) on monthly plan or 44,000 credits/year (360 min/year) on annual plan. Team collaboration, AI dubbing (70+ languages).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales / book demo. Unlimited video minutes, unlimited personal avatars, SAML/SSO, 1-click translation into 80+ languages, AI dubbing in 140+ languages, SOC 2 Type II certified.

vendors.name: HeyGen
vendors.provenance: HeyGen's pricing page (heygen.com/pricing) geo-redirected to EUR pricing in German. USD prices extracted from the FAQ section embedded in the same page, which explicitly states Creator at $29/mo ($24/mo billed annually), Pro at $49/mo, and Business at $149/mo plus $20/seat/mo. These USD figures were cross-checked against the SoftwareAdvice aggregator listing (which showed an older plan structure). The FAQ-sourced USD prices on the official page are treated as authoritative.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Limited free credits. Access to 120+ public avatars, 300+ voices. No personal avatar creation.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: $29/user/mo month-to-month; $24/user/mo billed annually (~17% off). 600 credits/month. Personal avatar creation, premium voices, auto captions, no watermark, 5-min max video duration.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $49/user/mo. Annual billing rate not confirmed from primary source. 1,000 credits/month. Advanced individual users, premium content at scale.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $149/mo base (includes multiple seats) plus $20/additional user/mo. 1,500 credits/month. API access, 4K resolution, brand kit. Annual billing rate not confirmed from primary source.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited video creation, custom seats, SSO (SAML), dedicated customer success manager, priority support, studio-quality production.

vendors.name: Pika
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from pika.art/pricing on 2026-06-14. Page defaults to annual billing with 'Yearly -20% off' toggle; month-to-month prices are not explicitly shown. monthlyUsd records the annual-equivalent monthly rate. Estimated month-to-month rates (20% higher) noted in plan notes. No enterprise or contact-sales tier was shown on the page. CORRECTION (verifier 2026-06-14): the three paid tiers were originally mislabeled Basic/Standard/Pro; Pika's actual paid tiers at these prices/credits are named Standard/Pro/Fancy (the real 'Basic' is the free 80-credit tier). Names corrected and cross-checked against magichour.ai/blog/pika-labs-pricing and the live pika.art/pricing extraction; prices ($8/$28/$76 annual) and credits (700/2,300/6,000) were already correct.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 80 monthly video credits (labeled 'Basic' on the page). 480p resolution only. Access to Pika 2.5, Pikascenes, Pikadditions, Pikaswaps, Pikatwists, Pikaffects. Watermarked downloads.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $8/mo billed annually; estimated ~$10/mo on monthly billing (20% premium, exact monthly rate not published on page). 700 credits/month. All resolutions. No watermark. Commercial use.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $28/mo billed annually (labeled 'Best value'); estimated ~$35/mo on monthly billing (20% premium, exact monthly rate not published). 2,300 credits/month. Faster generation speeds. All resolutions. No watermark. Commercial use.

plans.name: Fancy
plans.notes: $76/mo billed annually; estimated ~$95/mo on monthly billing (20% premium, exact monthly rate not published). 6,000 credits/month. Fastest generation speeds. All resolutions. No watermark. Commercial use. Includes Pikaframes.

vendors.name: Descript
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from descript.com/pricing on 2026-06-14. Both monthly and annual rates are explicitly published. Integrations list pulled from descript.com/integrations on same date. Enterprise requires contacting the sales team. Discount percentages vary per tier despite page advertising 'up to 35% savings'.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Text-based editing with limited AI tools access. No AI transcription hours or generative AI features at full capacity.

plans.name: Hobbyist
plans.notes: $24/user/mo month-to-month; $16/user/mo billed annually (~33% off). Billed per person.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: $35/user/mo month-to-month; $24/user/mo billed annually (~31% off). Most popular plan. Scales to 3-person teams.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $65/user/mo month-to-month; $50/user/mo billed annually (~23% off). Scales to 5-person teams.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Advanced security, SSO/SCIM, granular brand controls, custom AI credits, flexible licensing.

vendors.name: Captions
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from captions.ai/pricing on 2026-06-14. Page notes 'Features and prices reflect iOS plans only' — web/Android pricing may differ. Annual billing is offered at a discount but specific annual rates were not published on the pricing page. annualDiscountPct is null for all plans.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Basic trimming, transitions, and some media library assets. No generative AI features.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: $24.99/mo (most popular). 500 credits/month. AI Edit styles, digital twins (AI avatar), chat-based editor. Annual billing available at unspecified discount.

plans.name: Scale 2x
plans.notes: $69.99/mo. 1,400 credits/month. Access to sophisticated AI models. Annual billing available at unspecified discount.

plans.name: Scale 4x
plans.notes: $139.99/mo. 2,800 credits/month. Access to sophisticated AI models. Annual billing available at unspecified discount.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $279.99/mo. 5,600 credits/month. Highest self-serve tier. Annual billing available at unspecified discount.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Bulk credit discounts, custom seat options, dedicated account management, training data exclusion, priority support, early beta access.

vendors.name: Luma Dream Machine
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/pricing on 2026-06-14. Page displays monthly prices and notes 'Save up to 20% with yearly' but does not show the specific annual amounts — annual-equivalent rates of $25/$75/$250 are derived from the stated 20% discount and are estimates, not confirmed figures on the page. Team and Enterprise tiers show 'Contact us' with no published price.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: $30/mo month-to-month; ~$25/mo estimated on annual billing (20% off per page, exact annual amount not published). Includes Luma and third-party image/video models, commercial use.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $90/mo month-to-month; ~$75/mo estimated on annual billing (20% off per page, exact annual amount not published). Commercial use, edit access for guest collaborators.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: $300/mo month-to-month; ~$250/mo estimated on annual billing (20% off per page, exact annual amount not published). Highest individual self-serve tier.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Contact sales. Team management, shared credits, usage analytics.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Enterprise commitments, dedicated training, custom fine-tuning.
